title: ClawHavoc: 335 ClawHub skills used fake setup steps to install Atomic macOS Stealer
summary: An audit of all 2,857 skills then listed on ClawHub found 341 malicious ones, 335 of them from a single campaign whose SKILL.md files told the agent that a prerequisite named OpenClawCLI had to be installed and pointed the user at an attacker-controlled download that delivered a variant of Atomic macOS Stealer. A single account published 314 of the skills; by mid-February the marketplace had grown past 10,700 skills and the malicious count had reached 824.
severity_rationale: Commodity infostealer delivered at marketplace scale to machines chosen because they run an agent continuously, and the install instruction is laundered through the agent the user trusts.
